# PackinClub

> PackinClub is a B2B supplier of certified compostable packaging in India, based in Delhi. It supplies compostable bags, courier mailers, films, pouches, cups and mulch film in bulk to businesses such as e-commerce and D2C brands, restaurants and cloud kitchens, retailers, farms and nurseries, hospitals and temples. Products are made to Indian standard IS 17088 for compostable plastics and are CPCB certified. Minimum order is 100 kg per specification, and PackinClub sends samples and a quote within two business days.

PackinClub sells to businesses only (B2B), not to individual consumers. Products can be printed with a customer's brand using food-grade flexographic inks. Compostable packaging here means packaging designed to break down in managed industrial composting; it is not the same as "biodegradable" or "oxo-degradable" plastic, and the blog explains the difference.

- Quote and samples: within two business days via https://packinclub.com/contact.html

## Products

### Agriculture and Nursery
- [Compostable Agri Mulch Film](https://packinclub.com/products/compostable-agri-mulch-film.html): Suppresses weeds and holds soil moisture, then tills back into the earth, no retrieval, no residue.
- [Compostable Nursery Bags](https://packinclub.com/products/compostable-nursery-bags.html): Grow-bags that go straight into the ground at transplant, roots and all.

### Bags on Roll
- [Compostable Carry Bags on Roll](https://packinclub.com/products/compostable-carry-bags-on-roll.html): Perforated carry bags on a roll for fast, fuss-free dispensing at the till.
- [Compostable Garbage Bag on Roll](https://packinclub.com/products/compostable-garbage-bag-on-roll.html): Leak-resistant bin liners on a roll for busy kitchens and facilities.
- [Compostable Grocery Bags on Roll](https://packinclub.com/products/compostable-grocery-bags-on-roll.html): Tear-off grocery bags on a roll for produce sections and checkouts.

### Healthcare and Hospital
- [Compostable Medical Waste Bags](https://packinclub.com/products/compostable-medical-waste-bags.html): Colour-coded, compliant bags for the safe handling of non-hazardous clinical waste.

### HORECA
- [Compostable Bamboo Tissue](https://packinclub.com/products/compostable-bamboo-tissue.html): Soft, strong bamboo-pulp tissue for tables and washrooms, plastic- and chlorine-free.
- [Compostable Bread Pouch](https://packinclub.com/products/compostable-bread-pouch.html): Keeps loaves fresh and breathable, then composts along with the crumbs.
- [Compostable Cling Film](https://packinclub.com/products/compostable-cling-film.html): Clings and seals like conventional wrap, without the petroleum plastic.
- [Compostable Hot Liquid Pouches](https://packinclub.com/products/compostable-hot-liquid-pouches.html): Hold hot soups, curries, and beverages without leaching or leaking.
- [Compostable Aqueous Coated Paper Cups](https://packinclub.com/products/compostable-aqueous-coated-paper-cups.html): Aqueous-coated cups for hot and cold drinks, fully compostable, no plastic film.
- [Compostable Pouches](https://packinclub.com/products/compostable-pouches.html): Compostable pouches for packaging food, grains, and dry goods.

### Industrial
- [Compostable Electrical Wire Packaging Wrap](https://packinclub.com/products/compostable-electrical-wire-packaging-wrap.html): Protective wrap for spooled wire and cable, certified to compost.
- [Compostable Garbage Bags](https://packinclub.com/products/compostable-garbage-bags.html): Sturdy bin bags that hold the load, and break down after.
- [Compostable Shrink Film](https://packinclub.com/products/compostable-shrink-film.html): Shrinks tight around multipacks and trays, then composts away.
- [Compostable Stretch Film](https://packinclub.com/products/compostable-stretch-film.html): Compostable pallet wrap for end-of-line bundling and logistics.

### Retail
- [Compostable Carry Bags (W-cut, U-cut)](https://packinclub.com/products/compostable-carry-bags.html): Everyday retail carry bags in W- and U-cut styles, sized for any counter.
- [Compostable Courier Bags / Mailers](https://packinclub.com/products/compostable-courier-bags-mailers.html): Tamper-evident e-commerce mailers with a self-seal strip and write-on surface.
- [Compostable D-Cut Shopping Bags](https://packinclub.com/products/compostable-d-cut-shopping-bags.html): Premium D-cut shoppers with a clean, brandable finish.
- [Compostable Garment Bags](https://packinclub.com/products/compostable-garment-bags.html): Breathable garment covers that protect apparel in transit and storage.
- [Compostable Grocery Bags](https://packinclub.com/products/compostable-grocery-bags.html): Reliable grocery carriers for fresh produce and daily shopping.
- [Compostable Loop Handle Bags](https://packinclub.com/products/compostable-loop-handle-bags.html): Premium loop-handle bags for retail and gifting, with a refined feel.
- [Compostable Pet Poop Bags](https://packinclub.com/products/compostable-pet-poop-bags.html): Strong, leak-proof waste bags that don't outlive the walk.

### Temple and Religious
- [Compostable Prasadam Pouches](https://packinclub.com/products/compostable-prasadam-pouches.html): Food-safe pouches for temple prasadam and offerings.
